title: The School of Life
alternate_titles: The School of Life: An Emotional Education

editions.label: UK first edition
editions.publisher: Hamish Hamilton / The School of Life Press

contents: Introduction: the case for an emotional education
Self: self-knowledge, the influence of childhood, philosophical meditation
Others: charity of interpretation, politeness, vulnerability
Relationships: against romanticism; love as a skill rather than an emotion
Work: meaning, career anxieties, and the consolations of realistic ambition
Culture: art, ritual, and ideas as therapeutic resources

audiences: Readers who want a humane, literary introduction to emotional intelligence
People navigating love and relationship disappointments
Fans of The School of Life's videos and classes
Readers of philosophy who want it aimed at daily life
